name: Neon Cartridges
short_description: Atari-themed orchestrator for AI agents, MCP servers, and canvas workflows
detailed_description: Neon Cartridges is a retro-themed dashboard for orchestrating AI agents, MCP servers, and canvas workflows across VS Code instances. Load repo cartridges, run parallel/sequential workflow steps with MCP tools and Claude Code, manage permissions, and monitor activity — all from a single interface.
usage_instructions: Start the server, connect your VS Code instances with the Neon Cartridges extension, and manage all your AI agents and workflows from the dashboard.
author: Gridlight
